skill.summary: Create neutral, detailed handoff notes for co-parenting covering schedules, health, school, belongings, expenses, and follow-up questions to reduce conflict.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Co-Parenting Handoff Notes skill.
- Provides a neutral, structured note format for co-parenting exchanges.
- Covers schedule, health, school, belongings, expenses, and follow-up questions.
- Designed to reduce miscommunication and tension between co-parents.
- Supports safe and factual communication; not intended for legal or custody advice.
